adapter.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {b : Bool}, Nat.bit b n = 0 ↔ n = 0 ∧ b = false
adapter.note: batched: one adapter file carries all ten members of this family, one `lake env lean` compile and ten `lean4export` invocations for the whole dispatch.

producer.decline_message: terminal goal is not an exact Eq application after transparent reduction
producer.analysis: The terminal is `Iff` (`Nat.bit b n = 0 <-> n = 0 /\ b = false`). This producer recognises only an `Eq`-headed terminal; it has no `Iff.intro` leg and no conjunction introduction, so it stops at the shape test before attempting anything. This is the single largest decline class in the family -- four of the six -- and it is a MISSING CAPABILITY, not a wrong bound: `max_binders`/`max_inductions` were never approached.

disposition: epistemic_status stays open; no operation registered per ADR-0602 (admission precedes registration). The four SIBLING members the same producer did close in this dispatch are registered as authoritative-mathlib-nat-bit-constructor-family-v1.
